title: Event record
description: One line of an event segment (.troupe/events/<session>.jsonl). A segment starts with a header line, followed by one line per event. Lines are strict JSON: no duplicate keys, no NaN or Infinity.

format.title: Format
format.description: The record format version. A reader refuses a format it doesn't know.

header.title: Segment header
header.description: The first line of a segment: the session that wrote it, and the branch it was written on. A segment holds one session's events on one branch.

event.title: Event
event.description: One recorded event. Its id is the content hash of stream, stream_type, version, topic, parents and state, leaving out the state's timestamp and lineage. state is inline JSON when its bytes are canonical JSON; otherwise state_b64 holds the bytes.

parents.description: The ids of the stream's heads this event follows. Empty for a stream's first event; two or more for a settling event.

batch.description: The batch this line belongs to. A batch is all or nothing: a reader leaves out a batch whose lines aren't all present.

troupeEvent.title: Event troupe recorded
troupeEvent.description: An event troupe itself recorded: inline state that carries lineage.
